article.title: Cuban president says new economic reforms do not imply privatization
article.author: teleSUR Desk
article.content: On Monday, Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel asserted that the transformations included in the package of economic reforms do not imply a privatization process for state-owned enterprises. The post Cuban president says new economic reforms do not imply privatization appeared first on MR Online .
